results.summary: A THREE BEDROOM SEMI-DETACHED PROPERTY providing an excellent opportunity for first time buyers or investment with NO ONWARD CHAIN. The property comprises of Porch, Hallway, Two Reception Rooms, Conservatory, Kitchen, Three First Floor Bedrooms, Family Bathroom and Rear Garden. Energy Performance Rating: E. Council Tax Band: C. LOCATION: The property is conveniently located on this sought after road in Selly Park, ideally situated for transport links providing access to the City Centre from Selly Oak and University Train Stations, with regular bus services throughout the day along Bristol Road (A38). Important institutions locally include The University of Birmingham, The Queen Elizabeth and Priory Hospitals, as well as Birmingham Dental Hospital. There are a wide variety of shopping facilities including bars and restaurants both in Selly Oak and nearby Harborne and Edgbaston. Selly Park, Edgbaston and Harborne provide schooling for children of all ages including a number of well-known independent schools for boys and girls including the renowned King Edward Foundation schools together with a variety of sporting and recreational amenities including Edgbaston Priory Club (tennis, squash and leisure), Warwickshire County Cricket Club, Edgbaston Golf Club, Cannon Hill Park and the Midlands Art Centre. HOW TO GET THERE: Enter into Sat Nav: B29 7RQ General Advice: Before travelling a distance to view any property, to get a feel for the locality, many think it is worthwhile exploring the setting on Google Earth/Google Street Maps. SUMMARY: * A three-bedroom semi-detached property offered with no onward chain, presenting an excellent opportunity for first time buyers or investors. The property requires modernisation throughout and offers great potential for improvement. * A useful entrance porch providing shelter, leading through to the main hallway. The hallway offers access to the principal ground floor rooms, features stairs rising to the first floor, and benefits from useful understairs storage, creating a welcoming introduction to the home. * The property benefits from two well-proportioned reception rooms, each accessed separately from the hallway. The front reception room features a bay window, allowing for plenty of natural light, while the rear reception room enjoys patio doors leading through to the conservatory. The two rooms are also connected by internal double doors, offering flexibility to either create free-flowing living and dining space or maintain two separate reception areas, depending on preference. * A conservatory providing additional living space, with doors leading out to the rear garden. The room offers views over the garden and serves as a versatile area, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. * The kitchen is fitted with a range of base cupboards and wall-mounted units, providing ample storage. There is space for a cooker, fridge, freezer, and washing machine. A door leads to the side of the property, offering convenient access to the rear garden. * To the first floor, there are three bedrooms, all of a generous size, offering ample space for a range of furnishings and suitable for family living. * The family bathroom is fitted with a W.C., a freestanding wash hand basin, and a bath with an overhead shower. The room also benefits from an airing cupboard, providing additional storage. * The rear garden offers a versatile and well-laid-out outdoor space. Upon entering from the conservatory or rear of the house, there is a paved patio area ideal for seating or outdoor dining. Beyond this, a central pond provides a focal point, surrounded by a generous lawn that extends toward the rear boundary, offering space for children to play or for gardening. At the far end of the garden, a pebbled section creates a low-maintenance area, which houses a shed to the left for storage. Double gates at the rear provide convenient access, making it practical for additional parking or easy entry from the back. The property also benefits from side access. GENERAL INFORMATION: The central heating boiler is situated in the kitchen. TENURE: The agent understands the property is Freehold. results.summary: An immaculate and superbly designed five bedroom period residence situated in this highly desirable location in central Harborne just off the High Street. The property has been thoughtfully designed to incorporate luxurious internal living whilst retaining a host of original charm and heritage. Additionally boasting a garage and discreet driveway to the rear, with a beautiful rear courtyard. Being Sold with No Upward Chain. Built in the late 1800's, the property is set back away from the the road with a wrought iron gated boundary and a blue brick front courtyard with a beautiful feature miniature tree. As you enter through the hardwood entrance door you come into a welcoming tiled hallway with a partly tiled cloakroom and staircase to the first floor, with access down to a fully tanked basement perfect for storage. The elegant through reception room combines both the original front and rear rooms, with a large bay window to the front and two beautiful feature fireplaces. The front reception area also includes professional soundproofing, designed for audiophiles, with built-in high performance cables for superior audio and prevents sound transmission to the neighboring property. The rear reception area provides some built-in storage and shelving and provides internal double doors into the extended kitchen dining room. The extended kitchen has a vaulted ceiling with skylights and bi-folding doors out to the rear courtyard providing plenty of natural light. With ample space for a dining table and chairs, the fully integrated kitchen comprises wall and base level units with complimentary work surfaces and tiled splash-back. The appliances includes fridge and freezer, dishwasher and washing machine with a 'Rangemaster' style oven and hob with extractor fan. The upstairs accommodation is set over two floors and provides luxurious silk-blend carpets in all bedrooms to provide the ultimate comfort. To the first floor are two large double bedrooms, one with fitted wardrobes and a master bedroom with luxury en-suite comprising WC, wash hand basin and shower cubicle with high pressure spa-like power shower (3.5 bar), in addition the main bathroom on this floor comprises WC, vanity sink unit with built-in cabinet storage, bidet, large bath with marble surround and mixer taps with a separate shower cubicle. Completing the first floor is the storage cupboard which houses the top of the range "UV Gold" hot-water cylinder. The second floor is occupied by two further double bedrooms, most notably the third bedroom to the rear includes a fold-out balcony which offers panoramic views over Central Birmingham without sacrificing any interior floor space, additionally it also has a brilliantly designed, almost secret entry to a large multi-purpose room that would be a fantastic playroom for children or as a tranquil meditation space. The internal accommodation is completed with a fully tiled re-fitted shower room comprising WC, wash hand basin and walk-in shower cubicle with rain head shower. To the outside of the property is a wonderful blue brick courtyard providing wonderful outside space, featuring a custom garden mosaic which is the artistic centerpiece, perfect for the outdoor entertainment of guests. At the rear of the property is a discreet driveway which provides access to the detached wall-tiled car garage, it includes an electric roller style door and provides space for possibly two small or one larger vehicle with additional parking in front of the garage. Additionally at the rear is the secure separate access to the one bedroom self contained 'Picollo' apartment. With its own entrance the apartment is set above the garage and comprises studio bedroom and living area with a kitchenette and a bathroom. This dwelling is accessible without disturbing the main residence and could be used as an investment or separate annex for family or guests. The property is situated on this highly regarded road just off the infamous Harborne Village High Street, renowned for its range of high-end retail and independent stores along with several award-winning eateries in close proximity which includes Harborne Kitchen and The Plough gastro-pub to name a few. The property is also superbly positioned for convenient access to Queen Elizabeth Medical Complex and Birmingham University along with fantastic transport links into Birmingham City Centre. The local area is well renowned for its local school catchment with most notably Harborne Primary, Chad Vale and the Blue Coat school all in close proximity. Estate agents operating in the UK are required to conduct Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks in compliance with the regulations set forth by HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) for all property transactions. It is mandatory for both buyers and sellers to successfully complete these checks before any property transaction can proceed. Our estate agency uses Coadjute’s Assured Compliance service to facilitate the AML checks. A fee will be charged for each individual AML check conducted. Step through the welcoming porch into a bright entrance hall, setting the tone for the generous proportions found throughout. The expansive lounge provides an ideal space for relaxation and family gatherings, boasting ample room for comfortable furnishings. Adjacent to this, the dedicated dining room offers a wonderful setting for memorable meals and entertaining guests. The heart of this home is the well-appointed kitchen, designed for both everyday functionality and social enjoyment. Complementing the kitchen is a substantial utility room, providing invaluable practical space for laundry and additional storage, essential for any busy home. Upstairs, the thoughtfully arranged first floor features four generously sized, double bedrooms, each offering a peaceful retreat. The principal bedroom is a true sanctuary, benefiting from a private en-suite, providing a touch of luxury. The remaining three bedrooms are versatile and bright, sharing access to a modern shower room. results.summary: Dixons are proud to present this stunning house, located in the highly sought-after area of Harborne, this well-presented three-bedroom home offers spacious and comfortable living, perfect for families, first-time buyers, or those looking to upsize. The property is set back behind a charming front garden, adding a sense of privacy and curb appeal. On the ground floor, the home features a large kitchen complete with built-in appliances, providing lots of space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. To the rear, there is a generously sized living room benefits from a large double sliding patio door that opens directly onto the well-maintained rear garden, perfect for those summer nights and BBQs with friends and family. Upstairs, you will find three good-sized bedrooms, all offering ample space for beds and storage, making them perfect for a growing family or flexible use as a home office or guest room. The master bedroom also boasts a large built-in wardrobe. The family bathroom is beautifully presented, with a panelled bath and overhead shower, offering both convenience and comfort. results.summary: This is one of those homes that immediately stands out. Superbly presented throughout and finished to an exceptional standard, this immaculate two-bedroom semi-detached property offers stylish, modern living with the added benefit of no onward chain — ready for a buyer to move straight in and enjoy from day one.From the outset, the property impresses with its beautifully maintained frontage, landscaped with clean lines, a manicured lawn, and a smart driveway providing off-road parking. The kerb appeal here is undeniable and sets the tone for what’s to come inside. Step through the front door and the quality continues. The accommodation has been thoughtfully designed, with wider doorways throughout, originally built to accommodate wheelchair access — creating a noticeably more open, accessible, and user-friendly layout.The living room is a fantastic space — bright, contemporary, and finished with a striking media wall that creates a real focal point. To the rear, the kitchen is sleek and modern, offering ample storage, integrated appliances, and a practical layout that works perfectly for everyday living. Upstairs, the property offers two generous double bedrooms, both beautifully presented, along with a stylish, fully tiled shower room finished to a high standard. But what truly sets this home apart is the rear garden.Designed with a clear sense of style and tranquillity, the garden has been transformed into a stunning Japanese-inspired space. With clean landscaping, artificial lawn, feature paving, and a standout seating/pergola area, it offers the perfect balance of low maintenance and high impact. Whether entertaining or relaxing, this is a space that feels completely unique and far beyond the norm for properties in this price range. results.summary: This first floor flat is certainly not one to be missed as it is unusual to come across a property of such size and space within the city at this price. The property overall offers the same square footage as an average three bedroom house at 934 sq ft. To give you an even bigger thirst for this two bedroom home, it also comes with it's own private entrance on the ground floor which then leads you up the staircase to the first floor of the building and remainder of the accommodation to the dwelling. There is limited shared parking to the front of the development, with views across some greenery to the rear as the property overlooks a small park/playground & green. The property is split over two floors with the entrance hall being located on the ground floor meaning the access into the property is a private entrance with it's own front door. Up the stairs to the first floor and main residence, buyers shall be greeted with the scent of freshly painted walls and newly laid flooring since the current owner decided to have brand new bathrooms and a kitchen fitted ahead of the sale. It was also redecorated throughout, again with new flooring laid throughout too, so everything that you see in the property shall be included. The property itself briefly comprises of an entrance hallway with a larger than average storage cupboard (ground floor), inner hallway (first floor), extremely spacious lounge, newly fitted kitchen/diner with integral appliances, master bedroom with en-suite, an even larger second bedroom, family bathroom and gas central heating. There is also no upward chain involved with this purchase. The Freehold to the building is owned and managed by Birmingham City Council, meaning there is a ground rent and service charge applicable er annum. The vendor has informed us of the below leasehold information, however we do recommend that you conduct your own investigations into the leasehold information via your legal representative as we cannot guarantee the accuracy of the information: Front of Property To the front of the property is a slabbed pathway leading you to the front door of the dwelling. Ironmongery and a gate separate the pathway from the neighboring properties and the public footpath. Limited parking is available and is allocated to the use of the residents only. There is a security light above the solid wood front door which takes you into the ground floor entrance hallway. Entrance Hall (ground floor) Having the main front door leading into the property on the ground floor where there are stairs rising up to the first floor and a large storage cupboard that stretches to the depth of the staircase.. Inner Hallway (first floor) Providing access into all of the individual rooms within the property with the exception of the en-suite and laminated flooring. The staircase take you back down to the entrance hall. Lounge 15'11 max x 13'11 max 2 x windows to the rear overlooking the park, radiator, TV & Tel points, laminated flooring, LED spotlights to ceiling and a door leading into the hallway. Kitchen / Diner 14'00 max x 11'11 into doorway A range of newly fitted white high gloss wall & base units with work surfaces over, integral stainless steel electric oven and gas hob with cooker hood over, one bowl stainless steel sink/drainer with mixer tap over and Grey brick effect splash back tiling, storage cupboard housing the wall mounted combi boiler and also housing the plumbing facilities for the washing machine, there is also another second storage cupboard, tiled flooring, window to the front, radiator and space for an upright fridge/freezer, spotlights to ceiling and door leading back into the hallway. Family Bathroom Being completely tiled throughout on both the walls and flooring, chrome heated towel rail, storage cupboard, obscure window to the front, fitted high gloss panel bath with a chrome mixer tap/shower, ceramic low level wc, floating feature ceramic wash hand basin with chrome mixer taps and under storage, extractor fan, LED spotlights to ceiling and a door leading back into the hallway. Master Bedroom 13'10 max x 12'09 max Window to the front, radiator, LED spotlights to ceiling, storage cupboard and doors leading into both the en-suite and back into the hallway. Bedroom Two 16'00 x 10'08 2 x windows to the rear overlooking the park, radiator, laminated flooring, TV & Tel points, LED spotlights to ceiling and a door leading back out into the hall. Ensuite Shower Room Fully tiled throughout on both the walls and flooring, fitted double glass shower cubicle with a double headed shower over, low level wc, feature floating ceramic wash hand basin with under storage having a mahogany finish, extractor fan, obscure window to the front, chrome heated towel rail and door leading back into the bedroom. Rear of Property To the rear of the property is a public footpath providing pedestrian access onto the development. The path runs alongside a green and children's playground, however some of the green is fenced off for the use of residents to the ground floor dwellings. results.summary: Attractive mid-terrace home in a convenient Sparkhill location. The property includes driveway parking and easy access to local shops, schools, and transport links to Birmingham and Solihull. This charming mid-terrace home presents an appealing blend of traditional character and modern living, set in a convenient residential location within walking distance of Sparkhill's popular amenities. The exterior has been tastefully updated with a contemporary facade and driveway parking, while inside, a spacious layout offers comfortable family living. The bright lounge features elegant lighting, and a large window that brings in plenty of natural light. The kitchen and dining area at the rear of the property are designed for versatility, with access to the garden through French doors, creating an ideal space for family gatherings or entertaining. The fitted kitchen includes ample workspace, classic tiled splashbacks, and a feature range cooker. Upstairs, the home offers well-presented accommodation with stylish decor and distinctive detailing throughout. The bathroom is finished to a modern standard, featuring tiled walls, a white suite, and an overhead shower. The garden provides a generous outdoor area with a mix of lawn and patio space, ideal for summer relaxation or light gardening, all bordered by timber fencing for privacy. Located close to Stratford Road, this property benefits from excellent transport links into Birmingham city centre and Solihull, along with easy access to local schools, shops, and parks. Sarehole Mill, Hall Green's green spaces, and a selection of cafes and restaurants add to the area's appeal, making it a desirable spot for both families and commuters. results.summary: A beautifully presented detached family home set within this ever popular cul-de-sac location on the edge of Highbury & Cannon Hill Parks. The three bedroom accommodation has two reception rooms, a stylish refitted first floor shower room and enjoys delightful landscaped gardens to the rear. EP Rating D COUNCIL TAX BAND E TENURE: FREEHOLD Set within this much sought after cul-de-sac location is this beautifully presented detached family home set back from the road behind a paved driveway providing ample off road parking and flanked by mature borders and planting beds. There is a recessed porch area with composite entrance door leading to a spacious entrance hall with stairs to the first floor, ceiling cornicing & plate rails and doors to the kitchen, both reception rooms and guest cloakroom with white suite. The elegant sitting room has an Art Deco style fireplace, double glazed double doors to the rear garden, additional leaded double glazed window to the front and ceiling cornicing. The dining room has double glazed bi-fold doors to the delightful landscaped gardens. The kitchen is fitted with a range of panelled base and drawer units with inset sink unit, matching wall units, space for cooker and additional appliances and with door to the covered side verandah providing space for washing machine and with doors to the garage and rear garden. The attractive first floor landing is approached via a return staircase with feature double glazed original portrait window with ornate stained glass design. Panelled doors lead to three bedrooms and a shower room. Bedroom one has a full width range of fitted wardrobes with panelled mirrored doors. Bedroom two is a generous double and has a recently fitted range of wardrobes & bedroom three is currently used as a study. The stylish refitted shower room is fully tiled with a large walk-in shower with glass screen, wash hand basin with a range of vanity units below and low level w.c. The property has a single garage and stunning landscaped gardens to the rear with large terrace/outdoor entertaining area, shaped lawn with mature borders stocked with a wealth of shrubs and flowering plants and with many specimen plants and secluded seating areas. results.summary: Oakmans Estate Agents are delighted to present this beautifully presented and characterful four bedroom family home, ideally situated within one of Kings Norton’s most sought-after residential locations. Offering spacious and versatile accommodation alongside charming period features and a generous rear garden, this wonderful property provides an ideal setting for modern family living. Approaching the property you are greeted by an attractive front garden with wooden sleeper landscaping, creating a warm and welcoming aesthetic leading up to the front entrance. Upon entering the property, a beautiful entrance hallway provides access to the principal living spaces and sets the tone for the character and charm found throughout the home. Positioned to the front is a cosy family reception room featuring a large bay window allowing plenty of natural light and a charming log burner creating a comfortable and inviting space. To the rear sits a spacious living room, again benefitting from a log burner and offering access through into the conservatory, providing an additional reception area with views over the rear garden. The property also benefits from a large separate modern kitchen, offering generous worktop and storage space while providing direct access into the garden. Leading from the kitchen is a useful side extension which offers flexible living space currently used as a home office, alongside a utility area and convenient downstairs W.C. This area also provides access to the rear garden and a practical external storage space to the front, ideal for bin storage and log storage for the wood burners. Upstairs the property offers four well-proportioned double bedrooms along with a family bathroom, providing ample space for growing families. Externally, the property enjoys a substantial rear garden which is mainly laid to lawn, creating a wonderful green space for families and outdoor entertaining. A patio area located directly outside the kitchen provides the perfect seating area for relaxing or dining during warmer months. The property is located within the highly desirable Kings Norton area of South Birmingham, known for its historic village character, strong community feel and excellent local amenities. Kings Norton Green and the surrounding village area offer a selection of independent cafés, shops and traditional pubs, while nearby Cotteridge and Stirchley provide an even wider range of restaurants, supermarkets and everyday conveniences. Transport links are excellent, with Kings Norton train station offering direct routes into Birmingham City Centre, while the nearby A441 and Pershore Road provide convenient road access for commuting. The property is also well placed for access to the University of Birmingham and Queen Elizabeth Hospital, both approximately a short drive away, further enhancing the appeal of the location. This beautiful home combines character, space and a highly desirable location, making it a fantastic opportunity for families seeking a charming property within one of South Birmingham’s most sought-after neighbourhoods. To arrange your viewing, please call Oakmans Estate Agents today to avoid missing out. results.summary: Set within the sought after Sapcote Yard development, this beautifully designed three-bedroom townhouse offers contemporary living in the heart of Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter. Priced at £575,000 and extending to 1,313 sqft, the property is arranged across three well-planned floors, combining generous living space with high-quality finishes throughout. The ground floor features an open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, designed for modern lifestyles and enhanced by large windows that bring in excellent natural light. The fully integrated kitchen includes a dishwasher, fridge/freezer, washer/dryer, and electric hob and oven. On the upper floors, three well-proportioned bedrooms are complemented by two stylish bathrooms, finished with ceramic tiling and premium sanitaryware. Energy-efficient LED lighting, USB charging points, WiFi-controlled heating, and enhanced acoustic insulation provide comfort and convenience. A standout feature of this home is the private first-floor terrace, offering an ideal outdoor space for relaxing or entertaining. The property also benefits from one private parking space within the gated development, providing added security and practicality for city-centre living. Secure keypad entry, CCTV monitored access and robust fire safety systems further enhance peace of mind. Just a short walk from New Street Station, Colmore Business District, and a wide range of independent cafés, bars, and restaurants, this townhouse offers the perfect blend of modern living and vibrant city-centre convenience. Excellent transport links—Metro, Grand Central and Snow Hill Stations—are all within walking distance, offering fast and direct access to London, Manchester and Birmingham International Airport. The Jewellery Quarter is celebrated for its rich heritage and creative community, home to artisan workshops, independent boutiques, restaurants, bars and galleries. This vibrant neighbourhood blends historic character with modern urban living, making it one of Birmingham’s most desirable districts. results.summary: ** Open Day Event: Saturday 18th April ** Join us on Saturday 18th April between 9:30am - 4pm for our exclusive Shared Ownership viewing event at Perry Barr Village, and explore the development and 1 and 2 bed apartments available. Viewings are strictly limited and bookings are by appointment only, so to secure your place call us or request a place via the events page on the L&G Affordable Homes website. A stunning new 2 bedroom Shared Ownership apartment with great views and amenities with modern, open plan living area finished to a high standard, with integrated kitchen appliances in a great location in Perry Barr, just 13 minutes from Birmingham city centre from the nearby station. Welcome to Perry Barr Village a new community in the heart of the West Midlands - available to move in now – plus receive a £1,000 Deposit Boost Contribution* Highlight Housing, The Affordable Homes Agency, working with Legal & General's Affordable Housing Division (L&G), is pleased to present this Shared Ownership 2 bedroom apartment at Perry Barr Village, Birmingham. The price shown represents purchasing a 40% share. A superb collection of 1 and 2 bed apartments available with Shared Ownership across 3 separate blocks, with attractive communal spaces and a great location in Perry Barr, with Birmingham just 13 minutes away from the nearby station. Plot 07-A-02-05 is a 72.66 square metre two bedroom second floor apartment with a modern, open plan living area finished to a high standard, with a range of integrated appliances and balcony at Perry Barr Village, available to purchase through Shared Ownership from a 40% share. Financial Breakdown: Full Market Value: £204,000 40% Share Value: £81,600 5% deposit of 40%: £4,080 Rent on unowned share: £281 per month Service Charge: £244.42 per month You will find a new community, designed with high levels of sustainability, with shared public spaces, tree lined streets, with a green central space including a basketball court and children's play area at its heart. These apartments offer contemporary living with modern interiors finished to high specifications throughout. Presenting a range of designs, the apartments are generously sized and offer high quality kitchens with integrated appliances, flooring throughout and high quality bathroom fittings. Perry Barr is perfectly positioned and is designed with accessible transport in mind - no on-site parking, but everything you need is just steps away, including a great range of local shops and restaurants - the One Stop shopping centre is directly opposite, plus many amenities, schools, parks and open spaces close to hand. with Perry Barr railway station and several bus stops also close by, giving you great options for commuting. *A £1,000 deposit boost contribution amount is available for new home purchasers who reserve any 1, or selected 2 bedroom apartment that comes without allocated car parking, made between 1st March to 31st May 2026. See our website for full terms and conditions or speak to one of our Sales Consultant team. Local Area Living in Perry Barr Village gives you plenty of options on your doorstep, with the One Stop shopping centre just across the road with a wide range of shops and restaurants, while there are also many local amenities equipped with all the essentials for everyday living and more close by. Whether it's by road or rail, getting around has never been simpler. Perry Barr railway station is just a short walk away from the development and the journey to Birmingham New Street will take you just 13 minutes. Whilst by road, the A34 and M6 offer access to wider road networks. There are also 12 bus stops within easy walking distance of the development with regular buses taking approx. 35 minutes to Birmingham New Street. Your new home in Perry Barr Village will also open up a huge range of activities and opportunities to explore with numerous parks, nature reserves and woodland sites nearby, including Aston Park and Gardens, Perry Hall Park and Sandwell Valley Rspb reserve all within a short distance, so you can soon find the perfect place for a dog walk or picnic. While Birmingham will allow you to indulge in retail therapy in the Bullring shopping centre, with over 200 shops. To relax after a busy days shopping head to the canal quarter to enjoy some of the best bars and restaurants, or perhaps a visit to the Science Museum, Sealife centre, Legoland Discovery centre, Botanical Gardens and Cadbury World, gives you plenty of possibilities for a day out! What is Shared Ownership? Shared Ownership is a more affordable way to have the security and stability of owning your own home. Shared Ownership is a government backed part buy/part rent scheme designed to help you take that first step on the property ladder. The scheme enables buyers to purchase a share of the value of the home - this is usually between 10 to 75 percent of the value of the property - and pay a subsidised rent on the remaining portion. You have the option to buy a bigger share in the property at a later date (known as Staircasing). Legal & General Affordable Homes are a Registered Provider offering these homes for sale on a Shared Ownership basis. We are creating communities to live, grow and flourish and are committed to removing the stress and anxiety associated with moving house, whilst delivering customer satisfaction and quality new homes. Eligibility Criteria To be eligible for a home at Perry Barr Village, you'll need to: Have a combined household income under £80,000 per annum Not already own a property, or part of a property, at the time of completing on your purchase Be unable to purchase a suitable home to meet your housing needs on the open market Have a minimum of £5,000 to cover the costs of buying a home Customers with a live/work connection to Birmingham will be prioritised If you don't meet the eligibility criteria for this development, you may still qualify for a shared ownership purchase at one of our others, so take a look at our website for more information.

results.summary: Overview 18 Florence Road is a much loved, well-presented, 3-bedroom, period, terraced property, requiring some modernisation and improvement. Having been in the same family ownership for over 6 decades, this cherished home enjoys a most convenient cul-de-sac situation in this highly popular residential area and benefits from vacant possession and no chain. Vendor Comments This house has been our family home for over 60 wonderful years, and it is with some sadness and more than a few tears that we are putting our home on the market. A home that was bought for £5000 all those years ago has seen 4 generations make such wonderful memories, the large family Christmas gatherings, enjoying the lovely large garden that has seen its fair share of swings, slides and paddling pools over the years! A place where Dad would lovingly spend hours mowing the perfect lawn and tending to his flowers. The house was perfect for us as a family, lovely spacious rooms throughout, growing up we would never know where the sofa would be when we came home from school as Mom loved to move the living room furniture around! As a family we loved a party, our kitchen was always the one used to prepare the food as it had so much space and room for lots of helpers! The house holds such special memories for us with only a few mentioned here, from being born there to taking all the great grandchildren to visit their grandparents. A great location too with proximity to schools, bus routes, train station, motorway network and the airport. We hope the new owners will be as happy there as we have been. What more could you ask for! Tendure We have been advised that the property is FREEHOLD, however you should check this with your legal advisor before exchanging contracts. Local Authority Birmingham City Council - Tax Band B Services Mains gas, electricity (Both currently supplied by British Gas), water, drainage and sewerage (Severn Trent). According to OFCOM the maximum download/upload speeds are 1,800 Mbps and 220 Mbps respectively for this property. This three bedroom home is positioned between beautifully maintained front and rear gardens, with the additional benefit of Grove Park directly opposite. Approaching the property is an established front garden area providing excellent privacy, with a pathway approaching the property entrance, and side access. The entrance hallway provides the staircase to the first floor and meter cupboard, leading into a spacious open plan reception room which wraps around to the rear offering space for both living and dining room furniture, including dual aspect windows to the front and patio doors out to the rear garden. There are doors from both the dining area and hallway that lead into a spacious breakfast kitchen which comprises wall and base level units, with complimentary work surfaces and tiled splash-back; there is an integrated oven with electric hob and extractor with space for all other freestanding kitchen appliances whilst also housing the central heating boiler. There is also access out to the rear garden from the kitchen area. The upstairs accommodation provides three generously sized bedrooms, all of which include a form of fitted wardrobes or storage. Outside at the rear is a, wider than average for the area, south facing garden which includes a rear gated access, with patio area, a brick outbuilding and a fenced boundary. The property is situated in this sought after Harborne location, within close proximity of a variety of local amenities including shops, cafés and transport facilities, and with Grove Park also offering a fantastic green landscape on the doorstep. The driveway provides off road parking and cast iron gates lead to the shared driveway giving access to the garage at the rear. A double glazed entrance door with arched windows and top light lead to a spacious entrance porch with half glazed leaded inner door flanked by original stained glass Arts & Crafts windows and top light giving access to the reception hall. The impressive reception hall has stairs to the first floor and door to a deep walk-in under stairs cloaks/storage room providing excellent storage space with door and window to the side and space for fridge/freezer. There is wooden flooring, ceiling cornicing, feature original fireplace and mantel with tiled inset and raised hearth and doors to both reception rooms & kitchen and door to guest cloakroom with white suite. The front reception room has a deep leaded walk-in bay window to the front, original stained glass window to the side, wooden flooring, picture rails & ceiling cornicing and feature pine fireplace and mantel with tiled inset and cast iron grate. The rear reception room has wooden flooring, ceiling cornicing, feature carved fireplace and mantel with marble inset and double doors flanked by matching side windows giving access to the conservatory with laminate flooring, glazed roof and double glazed double doors flanked by matching side windows leading out to the rear garden. The kitchen is fitted with a range of white high gloss base units with inset sink unit, matching wall units, integrated dishwasher, stainless steel oven with electric ceramic hob and extractor fan over, wall mounted gas central heating boiler and door leading out to the spacious utility with fitted storage and providing space for washing machine, tumble dryer and fridge/freezer. A door leads to the side driveway. The first floor landing is approached via a return staircase with original stained glass window. There is a door leading to the stairs to the second floor and doors leading to the bathroom, three double bedrooms and good size single. The bedrooms all have double glazed windows and bedroom two is fitted with a range of wardrobes with sliding doors. The bathroom is fully tiled and has a white suite comprising panelled bath with chrome mixer tap and shower attachment, additional shower over the bath, pedestal wash hand basin and low level w.c. The fifth bedroom is on the second floor with a deep walk-in dormer window and door to fully tiled en-suite shower room with white suite. The lovely mature rear garden has a full width decked sun terrace/outdoor entertaining area and steps flanked by balustrades lead down to a meandering paved and gravel pathway through the garden and flanked by mature side borders with a wealth of established shrubs and flowering plants, ornamental pond and lower paved seating area. results.summary: Dixons are pleased to present this three bedroom end-terraced EXTENDED family home within walking distance of Erdington high street. This residence is ideal for families, couples or investors providing a good living space with plenty of potential. The property benefits from its exceptional location with everything you need all within walking distance. Local shops, schools, amenities and communal parks. Commuters will appreciate the readily-available bus links to surrounding towns such as Birmingham City Centre, Wylde Green and Sutton Coldfield, while Erdington and Gravelly Lane train stations provide convenient cross-country rail services for seamless connectivity. The ground floor accommodation begins of two spacious reception rooms. First room, sitting at the front elevation, holds bay window to the front for a bright/welcoming atmosphere. Following into the second reception room which provides a cosy yet fresh feeling with a brick chimney breast. A sleek, fully fitted kitchen makes use of the space provided with worktops and a good range of storage cupboards. With the added extension this property also has a utility, ground floor bathroom and third reception room sitting at the rear with patio door looking out to the low maintenance rear garden. Upstairs on the first floor, holds three bedrooms and a secondary bathroom. The main bedroom overlooks the front of the house and provides an additional built in storage cupboard. The second bedroom, also a generous size, has a window facing out to the rear for a light and fresh feeling. The third room easily fitting a single bed and wardrobes, could also be used as a home office or additional storage depending on the needs. Furthermore this property on offer benefits from a front garden, gas central heating and double glazing (both where specified). Viewings are highly recommended to appreciate the accommodation on offer. results.summary: As you approach the property, the landscaped front garden gives an early hint that there is something truly special behind the front door. Lovingly restored over the past 20 years by the current owners, this home is a real showstopper. Stepping inside, you immediately get a sense of the high-end design and quality finishes throughout. From the hallway, you first enter one of two reception rooms. With a bay window overlooking the front, this space feels calm and inviting — the perfect place to relax. Back into the hallway, the second lounge delivers a real “wow” moment. With its bold yet tasteful décor and stunning wooden herringbone flooring, it feels more like a boutique hotel than a typical home. High ceilings, a large window overlooking the garden, and beautiful finishes make this a room you’ll be proud to show off. Leading directly from here is the kitchen, which has been fitted to an exceptional standard and includes all the integrated appliances you would expect. This space opens into the extended dining area, featuring bifold doors onto the garden and Velux windows above, allowing natural light to flood in. The design of the ground floor has to be seen to be fully appreciated. Upstairs, the property continues to impress. The main bedroom, located at the front, is a generous size and benefits from dual aspect windows, filling the room with natural light. Finished to the same high standard, it’s a space you’ll truly enjoy spending time in. The second bedroom offers excellent built-in storage, thoughtfully designed and crafted by a local carpenter, and comfortably accommodates a double bed along with additional furnishings. The bathroom is another standout feature. The timeless roll-top bath perfectly complements the character of the home, while a separate large walk-in shower adds a modern touch — creating a space that is both stylish and practical. Outside, the landscaped garden is a true oasis. Bifold doors from the dining area open onto a patio, seamlessly extending the living space outdoors. The lawn is surrounded by mature trees and raised flower beds, leading to a second patio area and a large garden shed for additional storage. It’s a peaceful setting where you could easily forget you are in the heart of the city. This is a truly unique and special home. The current owners have put great care and thought into every detail, creating a property that is both beautiful and functional and ready for its next owner to enjoy. In addition, Rubery benefits from superb transport links, with easy access to the A38, M5 and M42 motorway networks. Upstairs, the home offers four generously sized bedrooms. The impressive principal bedroom occupies the second floor, complete with mirrored fitted wardrobes and a contemporary en-suite shower room. Three additional double bedrooms are served by a modern family bathroom. OUTSIDE: Externally, the property benefits from a single garage with power and lighting. The enclosed rear garden enjoys a high degree of privacy and is of low maintenence featuring mature plants and trees. This recently renovated property offers an excellent opportunity for those seeking a versatile mixed-use space, currently arranged as a stylish salon on the ground floor with a well-presented one-bedroom flat above. Thoughtfully updated within the last three years, it combines an attractive commercial setting with comfortable living accommodation, making it ideal for business owners, investors, or those looking to maximise both residential and business potential. The ground floor provides a bright and contemporary salon area with quality finishes and modern décor, creating a professional and welcoming environment for clients. To the rear, a practical utility room, store area, and WC add to the functionality of the space, ensuring it is well-suited to a range of commercial uses. Upstairs, the spacious one-bedroom flat offers well-proportioned living accommodation. The open-plan kitchen and living area features modern units, sleek worktops, and integrated appliances, providing a comfortable and practical space for day-to-day living. A generous double bedroom is positioned to the rear, creating a private retreat, while the bathroom is finished to a high standard with a bath, shower over, and contemporary fittings. Externally, the property benefits from a private, low-maintenance courtyard garden, offering an ideal outdoor area for relaxing or entertaining. Located in a convenient and well-connected position, the property enjoys easy access to local amenities, excellent transport links, and nearby residential areas, making it an attractive option for both personal and investment purposes. Situated in the heart of Harborne, this property enjoys an excellent location just a short distance from the vibrant High Street, renowned for its wide selection of independent shops, cafés, bars, and restaurants. The area is also well regarded for its excellent leisure facilities, including Harborne Pool and Fitness Centre, local golf clubs, and scenic walking routes. Transport links are superb, with regular bus services providing direct routes into Birmingham city centre and surrounding areas, while nearby University and Selly Oak train stations offer further connectivity. The property is also within easy reach of the Queen Elizabeth Hospital, the University of Birmingham, and several other key local landmarks. Families and professionals alike benefit from access to outstanding educational facilities, including highly regarded primary and secondary schools, along with respected independent options such as Blue Coat, Edgbaston High School for Girls, and King Edward"s. This combination of excellent local amenities, strong transport connections, and a thriving community makes Harborne a consistently popular location for both business and residential purposes. MASTER BEDROOM: With carpeted flooring, coving detailing, ceiling light and built-in storage. Cast Iron fireplace with wooden mantelpiece, gas radiator and 2 large windows to front aspect. REAR BEDROOM: With carpeted flooring, ceiling light, gas radiator and window to rear aspect. results.summary: Angel Estates - 'Your Housing Guardians' are pleased to offer this traditional 'Grade II Listed', two bedroom semi-detached cottage to the local market 'For Sale' within tranquil location and offered with No Upward Chain. Benefits from gas central heating, spacious rooms throughout and a superb setting within this leafy neighbourhood. Briefly comprises of:- Entrance, reception room, inner lobby with storage and utility space either side leading into open-plan kitchen/dining room. Stairs from kitchen/dining room lead to first floor landing with two bedrooms, airing cupboard and large family bathroom. Front terrace, side gated access to paved courtyard garden to rear completes the layout. Ideal purchase for either an 'Investor' or 'First-Time Buyer' with many amenities a short distance away. Internal inspection strongly recommended to avoid disappointment! Entrance: From pavement, brick-built wall with raised front terrace, paved path to side gate which provides access to communal pathway leading to rear courtyard/garden. Path also to front entrance with hardwood door with stained glass arched panel above leads into:- Reception Room: 15'5'' (max, into recess) 14'2'' (min) x 10'2'' Laminate flooring, single panel radiator, light fitting to ceiling, single glazed sash bow window to front elevation and two built-in cupboards (housing gas meter and electric meter and fuse board separately). Panelled door to rear leads into:- Internal Lobby: (Unmeasured) Laminate flooring and open access to side leads into utility/storage area (4'2'' x 2'9'') with laminate flooring, pendant light fitting to ceiling, 'hot and cold' water feed for appliance, single glazed window to side elevation, wall mounted document/key box and power socket. Opposite, panelled door leads into under stairs storage cupboard (2'10'' x 2'3'') also with laminate floor, coat rail and shelving to wall. Open-access to rear, leads into:- Kitchen/Dining Room: 15'4'' (max, into recess) 14'1'' (min) x 9'9'' Laminate flooring, track-style spotlights to ceiling, double panel radiator, single glazed window to rear elevation, Main central heating boiler and control panel to wall. Kitchen comprises of:- Kitchen base, drawer and wall units, work surfaces with partly tiled walls as splashback, single bowl sink, drainer and mixer tap, built-in cupboard within recess above far work surface with internal shelving. Electric fan assisted oven, four burner gas hob and extractor fan above. From kitchen, panelled door and carpeted stairs with handrail to wall leads up to first floor landing, access to loft space and pendant light to ceiling. Panelled door to side leads into:- Bedroom One (Front): 14'2'' x 10'2'' Carpeted flooring, single panel radiator, pendant light fitting to ceiling and two single glazed windows to front elevation with secondary glazing within. From landing, panelled door to side leads into:- Bedroom Two (Rear): 10'3'' x 9'5'' Carpeted flooring, single panel radiator, pendant light fitting to ceiling and single glazed window to rear elevation (with louvered section to top of window for ventilation). From landing, panelled door into:- Airing Cupboard: 2'9'' x 2'4'' Exposed floor boards, hot water tank with slatted shelves above. From landing, panelled door to side leads into:- Family Bathroom: 10'1'' x 8'2'' Linoleum flooring, enclosed lighting to ceiling, single panel radiator and single glazed window with obscured glass to rear elevation (with louvered section to top of window for ventilation). Bathroom suite comprises of:- Panelled bath with fully tiled walls around 'wet area' electric shower and glass shower screen above, low-level flush toilet, pedestal wash basin with tiled splashback, glass shelf and wall mounted mirror above. Outside: From kitchen/diner, glass panelled door with single step-down leads onto two-tier blue brick paved rear courtyard, gated access to communal pathway to side which provides access to frontage, raised planting bed, mature shrubs to left-hand side boundary fencing which leads to rear fire exit (for adjacent commercial building). Wooden door to side provides access to brick-built outhouse (5'7'' x 3'2'' - no power supply or lighting). Services: All mains gas, electricity and water are connected; none of these services have been tested during our inspection. Tenure: We are advised that the property is Freehold, confirmation of which should be obtained by reference to the title deeds. Local Authority Charge: (Financial Year 2025-26) The property has been 'Banded D' (information correct as per Valuation Office Agency website) and falls under the jurisdiction of Birmingham City Council. For the current financial year, council tax charges are £2,237.00 per annum (subject to annual increment). results.summary: A beautiful 3 bedroom character home on the ever desirable Hartledon Road. This well-proportioned property is arranged over three floors and offers a versatile layout that combines traditional charm with practical modern living. To the front, the dining room benefits from a bay-style window that draws in plenty of natural light, creating a bright and inviting setting ideal for both formal dining and everyday use. Its position at the front of the property gives it a pleasant, elevated outlook and a sense of separation from the rest of the house. Moving through, the living room provides a comfortable and well-balanced space, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, with enough room for a variety of furniture arrangements. The connection between the two reception rooms allows for flexibility in how the spaces are used, whether kept separate or opened up for a more sociable layout. A useful storage area and the staircase are centrally positioned, ensuring the ground floor remains both practical and uncluttered. To the rear, the property opens into a generously extended breakfast kitchen that serves as the heart of the home. The long, linear design provides an abundance of worktop and storage space, making it highly functional for cooking and day-to-day living. There is also ample room for informal dining, allowing the kitchen to double as a social space for family meals or casual gatherings. Its position to the rear offers a degree of privacy from the main reception areas, while also creating a natural transition towards the outdoor space. With ample room for seating and dining furniture, the area can comfortably accommodate family gatherings or social occasions while still maintaining a relaxed atmosphere for quieter evenings. Its location ensures that it remains closely connected to the dining space, making it ideal for both daily use and entertaining guests. The sleeping accommodation is arranged along a central hallway, offering a sense of privacy from the main living spaces. The property features three well-proportioned bedrooms, each providing comfortable accommodation with flexibility for a range of needs. The principal bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, while the second bedroom benefits from its own ensuite shower room, adding convenience and a degree of independence for occupants or guests. The third bedroom provides further flexibility and could easily serve as a guest room, home office, or hobby space depending on lifestyle requirements. A family bathroom is also located off the hallway, providing a well-positioned facility for the remaining bedrooms and guests. In addition, a separate WC enhances practicality for a busy household. Built-in storage cupboards within the hallway provide useful space for household items, helping to keep the living areas tidy and well organised. Externally, the property offers further practical benefits. A detached garage provides secure parking or valuable additional storage space. To the rear of the property there is also a substantial outbuilding, which offers excellent versatility. This space could be used as a workshop, studio, hobby room, home gym, or additional storage area, making it particularly appealing for buyers seeking adaptable space outside the main house. The area is particularly known for its welcoming community atmosphere and its attractive high street, which forms the heart of the neighbourhood. Harborne High Street offers a wide and varied selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, and independent shops, alongside well-known retailers and everyday conveniences. This creates a lively yet relaxed village-like environment where residents can enjoy dining, socialising, and shopping close to home. The area continues to attract a wide range of residents thanks to its combination of traditional charm and modern amenities. The availability of quality education options has helped establish Harborne as one of Birmingham"s most desirable residential locations for those looking to settle long term. These major employers, together with the nearby medical and research facilities, contribute to the area"s dynamic and diverse community. Transport links are another key advantage of the location. Harborne offers convenient road connections to Birmingham city centre as well as the wider motorway network, making commuting straightforward. Regular bus services operate through the area, providing reliable public transport options into the city and neighbouring districts. Overall, Harborne offers an excellent balance between a peaceful residential setting and the convenience of city living. Its combination of local amenities, community atmosphere, green spaces, and accessibility continues to make it one of Birmingham"s most popular and enduringly attractive places to live. results.summary: A superb double fronted semi detached Victorian family home, offering versatile character accommodation with six double bedrooms and benefiting from four reception rooms, bespoke conservatory and mature gardens. EP Rating E COUNCIL TAX - BAND F TENURE - FREEHOLD Set back from the road behind a low level brick wall with wrought iron double gates leading to a blue brick pathway flanked by mature planting beds with established shrubs. Access is given to double wooden doors with Gothic style arched top light over leading to the entrance vestibule with original Minton tiled floor and panelled inner door with ornate stained glass inset flanked by matching side windows to the reception hall. The L-shaped reception hall has an original Minton tiled floor, original ceiling cornicing & picture rails, stairs to the first floor with spindle balustrade, access to a walk-in cloakroom room with doors to the side entry and cellar and panelled doors lead in turn to the ground floor accommodation. The spacious cloakroom has a white suite, stripped wooden floor, dado rails and picture rails and the study has a feature pine fireplace & mantel with cast iron inset, ceiling cornicing & picture rails and two double storage cabinets with display shelving over. The front reception room has a stripped wooden floor, feature fireplace and mantel with tiled inset and hearth, cornicing & picture rails and bespoke storage cabinets with display shelving over. The elegant sitting room has a stripped wooden floor, deep ceiling cornicing, fitted storage and display shelving and double doors lead to the bespoke conservatory of wooden framed double glazed construction with double doors to the garden, vaulted ceiling, tiled floor and connecting door to the kitchen. The kitchen is fitted with a range of panelled base and drawer units with solid wood work tops and inset Belfast sink, spaces for dishwasher and fridge/freezer, windows to both sides & double doors to the garden, door to large pantry and open access to an additional dining/living space with original crockery store with stripped pine doors. The cellar provides additional storage and the split level first floor landing leads to the laundry with fitted storage, spaces for washing machine & tumble dryer, two wall mounted gas central heating boilers and low level w.c. There are three double bedrooms with period fireplaces, cornicing & picture rails and fitted wardrobes. The large bathroom has a white suite comprising panelled bath, pedestal wash hand basin, low level w.c. and large shower cubicle. The second floor landing leads to three further double bedrooms, one fitted with a kitchenette area and an impressive bathroom with exposed beams and lintels, white suite and double glazed skylights. The mature south facing garden has a secluded paved seating area and mature lawn with established shrubs, trees & flowering plants, timber shed and greenhouse. results.summary: Offered with no onward chain, this beautifully presented, three-bedroom, terraced house in Birmingham presents a generously sized lounge, spacious fitted breakfast kitchen, Two double and one single bedrooms, family bathroom, plenty of storage, versatile rear garden, off-street parking and is in a prime position for amenities. Approaching the property, there is a tarmac drive allowing for parking multiple vehicles allowing front access to the hall and rear garden access through a gated side alley. Entering the property to the hall, there is immediate access to the generously sized lounge, hosting space for multiple suites and front facing bay window allowing for plenty of illumination. The fitted breakfast kitchen is spacious and presents ample counterspace with integral electric oven, sink with drain, dishwasher, storage cupboard and breakfast counter with barstool seating. Additionally, there is space for freestanding appliances and rear garden access. Ascending to the first floor, the landing presents Bedroom One, a large double looking to the front aspect through a front facing bay window offering plenty of illumination. Bedroom Two is also a large double looking to the rear aspect. Bedroom Three is a large single, looking to the rear aspect with space/plumbing for freestanding appliances, currently being used as an office/utility. The family bathroom presents a washbasin, WC and bath/shower while offering an integral airing cupboard for storing towels. The rear garden opens to a paved patio offering room for garden furniture and external storage, continuing to a raised grass laid lawn there is ample space for outdoor activities. The garden is completed by a gate leading to the front drive and a border of wooden panel fencing. Nearby to plenty of amenities including shops, schools and public transport links all located nearby. In close proximity to Longbridge train station, and Longbridge town centre which offers a wider range of local amenities and shops. Conveniently positioned for travel via road to Birmingham city centre, the M5 and M42 motorways. With several well-regarded primary and secondary schools are also located nearby some of which are within walking distance. results.summary: Nestled in a sought-after location, this charming semi-detached house offers a blend of comfort and potential, perfectly suited for investors or first-time buyers. As you step through the open hallway, you are greeted by a spacious through lounge that boasts the luxury of dual aspect windows, inviting natural light from the front, through a classic bay window, and the rear. This space holds the possibility to be reimagined into two separate receptions, as seen in neighbouring homes. The kitchen, conveniently fitted with integrated oven and hob, offers a practical layout with direct access to a side passageway. This passage is ideal for storing white goods or, subject to planning permission, could be transformed to extend the kitchen, thereby enhancing the functionality of the heart of the home. The upstairs comprises three ready-to-use bedrooms and a pristine family bathroom featuring a bath with an overhead shower, presenting a move-in-ready opportunity. Externally, the property is enveloped by a neat front garden, offering a welcoming first impression. Whilst currently unused for parking, there is potential to convert the front garden into off-road parking, subject to planning permission. The rear of the property presents a wonderfully mature garden that benefits from prolonged sunlight exposure, with possibilities that go beyond the visible rear fence. Previously hosting a garage and rear access, this area invites you to reintroduce these elements, providing expanded garden space and convenient canal access—a serene addition for leisurely strolls. The garden’s level surface makes it a safe and ideal play area for young children, distinguishing it from neighbouring properties on the street. Situated in an area renowned for its rising property values, this home is strategically positioned near a host of amenities and reputable schools. The exceptional transport links enhance its appeal, with convenient access to four nearby towns and proximity to major motorways just a couple of roads away, making commuting effortless. Whether you're venturing into homeownership for the first time or seeking a promising investment, this home encompasses both present-day comfort and future potential, within a community that offers both tranquillity and accessibility. results.summary: Positioned within a quiet cul-de-sac on the sought-after Lordswood Gardens estate, this beautifully presented three-storey home offers just over 1,300 sq ft of well-balanced, modern accommodation designed perfectly for family life. The property opens into a welcoming entrance hall leading through to a contemporary open-plan kitchen/diner — a bright and sociable space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. With integrated appliances, generous worktop space and ample room for dining, this area forms the true heart of the home. A dedicated study provides flexibility for home working or additional family needs, while a downstairs WC and useful storage enhance the practicality of the ground floor. The first floor hosts a spacious and light-filled living room, creating a relaxing retreat away from the main living areas — a signature feature of this popular three-storey layout. Also on this level is a well-proportioned double bedroom with its own modern ensuite shower room. The top floor offers two further double bedrooms, both beautifully maintained and ideal for children, guests or adaptable family use, all serviced by a sleek and contemporary family bathroom. A particular highlight of this home is the newly landscaped rear garden, thoughtfully designed with modern touches including external lighting to create a tranquil and inviting outdoor setting. Whether enjoying summer evenings, entertaining guests or simply unwinding, this space provides the perfect private retreat. Further benefits include a private driveway and garage for convenient off-road parking and storage, along with double glazing and gas central heating throughout. A superb opportunity to secure a spacious and stylish home within a peaceful cul-de-sac setting. Area Perrott Way forms part of the highly regarded Lordswood Gardens, built by David Wilson Homes, and positioned just off Bernard Road and Portland Road within a well-established and family-friendly neighbourhood. The development benefits from attractive communal green space and a children's play area, making it particularly appealing for young families seeking both community and convenience. The location offers exceptional access to key employment hubs, including City Hospital, the Queen Elizabeth Hospital, Metropolitan Hospital, and the wider Medical Quarter, alongside a straightforward commute to the University of Birmingham. The amenities of Edgbaston Village, Bearwood and Harborne are all within easy reach, providing an excellent selection of independent cafés, quality restaurants and everyday shopping facilities. Commuters are well served by strong transport links into Birmingham city centre, with nearby arterial routes offering convenient access to the M6 and M40 motorway network. Public transport connections are also readily available. Families benefit from a number of highly regarded schools close by, including Shireland Primary School, George Dixon Academy, Lordswood Girls' School and St Paul's School for Girls, in addition to a wide choice of respected independent schools across Edgbaston. For leisure and outdoor enjoyment, residents have access to Edgbaston Reservoir within walking distance, along with Summerfield Park and Cannon Hill Park for weekend walks, cycling and family outings. Sporting facilities such as Edgbaston Priory Club and Edgbaston Golf Club are also nearby, while Birmingham's premier retail destinations, including The Mailbox and Bullring, are easily accessible. The property welcomes you into a bright and spacious reception room, leading through to a generous kitchen diner—perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen, positioned at the rear, offers ample storage and worktop space, with a recently renovated ground-floor bathroom located just beyond for added practicality. Upstairs, you’ll find three well-proportioned bedrooms, offering flexible accommodation to suit a range of needs. To the rear, the property boasts a generous garden, complete with a substantial wooden outbuilding currently used as a gym. This versatile space could easily be adapted into a home office, hobby room, or additional living area. There is also convenient side access via a pathed alleyway. The front walled area adds kerb appeal, while the private rear garden provides a great space for relaxing or entertaining. Ideally situated within walking distance of the popular Handsworth Park and Wellbeing Centre, offering a gym, fitness classes, and a swimming pool. results.summary: A WELL LOCATED THREE BEDROOMED SEMI-DETACHED RESIDENCE IN THIS POPULAR KINGS NORTON LOCATION offers off-road driveway parking and a generous rear garden with the potential for extension (subject to the usual planning permissions). EP Rating: TBC LOCATION Kings Norton, Birmingham, dates back to 13th Century and still retains some of its early ‘village character’ particularly around The Green. The Green at Kings Norton has been the site of St Nicolas' Church since Norman times. Set on either side of which are the award winning Tudor Merchant’s House and the 17th century Old Grammar School. Now a hive of activity with shops, businesses and a regular farmers market. Kings Norton is highly accessible to Birmingham via road and rail links and to Worcestershire, Warwickshire and beyond via the M42 Motorway. The Train Station in Kings Norton provides easy access to the City Centre with a journey time to New Street station of around 20 minutes with intervening stations ideal for the Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the University of Birmingham. Local access to good schools is excellent both at primary and secondary levels. Kings Norton provides areas of natural beauty to include Merecroft Pool, Kings Norton Nature Reserve and a large local park. Other facilities locally include a Tennis Club, Kings Norton Golf Club and Kings Norton Business Centre with over 80 companies on site. results.summary: ***OPEN HOUSE – SATURDAY 28TH MARCH – 11AM –1PM *** Built circa 1934, Weatheroak is a delightful, detached country residence enjoying a peaceful and idyllic setting along a private lane, directly opposite the renowned Fulford Heath Golf Club. With its attractive black and white timbered façade, generous frontage and mature gardens, the property combines period charm with exciting potential for further enhancement. Approached via a wide tarmac driveway providing ample parking, the house sits proudly within its plot with a welcoming storm porch featuring terracotta tiled flooring and an oak front door. Inside, the property retains many hallmarks of its era, including high ceilings, large windows, and well-proportioned rooms that create a bright and airy living environment. Accommodation A welcoming reception hall provides access to the principal rooms and includes a useful under-stairs storage cupboard. The kitchen features oak cabinetry with a range of floor and wall units, integrated oven and grill, ceramic electric hob with extractor above, built-in fridge, twin sinks with drainer and a breakfastbar seating area. A picture window enjoys views over the rear garden. A ground floor WC and boiler cupboard housing the oil-fired boiler are positioned conveniently between the kitchen and utility area. To the side of the property is an exceptionally spacious utility and laundry room, fitted with additional kitchen units, stainless steel sink, ceramic tiled flooring and ample space for appliances including washing machine, dryer and fridge freezer. From here there is internal access to the integrated single garage, which benefits from an electric up-and-over door and loft storage above. A covered side passage with polycarbonate roof provides convenient access from the front to the rear garden. This entire side of the property offers huge scope for extension and development. The living room is a charming space overlooking the pretty rear gardens and offering the perfect space for family and friends to relax and entertain. A delightful feature of the room is a striking brick-built fireplace with a real wood and coal fire as its focal point. Picture windows flank the fireplace while dual-aspect glazing overlooks both the garden and terrace. An arched opening leads to a charming library area, complete with patio doors opening onto the garden, offering a peaceful reading or study space. The dining room is another elegant reception room, enjoying a bay window to the front and additional windows to the side, creating a light-filled setting ideal for entertaining. Upstairs, a dog-leg staircase leads to the first-floor landing, where a large picture window floods the space with natural light. The principal bedroom is a spacious retreat with fitted wardrobes, attractive garden views and a dressing/vanity area leading into a private en-suite shower room with shower cubicle, wash basin and WC. The second bedroom mirrors the proportions of the dining room below, featuring a bay window to the front, additional side windows, and extensive fitted wardrobes. A freestanding hand basin adds further convenience. The third bedroom is also a comfortable double with built-in wardrobes and pleasant views over the rear garden. A family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms and includes a bath, pedestal wash basin, WC, airing cupboard and dual aspect obscure windows providing natural light. Gardens & Grounds Weatheroak enjoys a beautifully private south west facing garden, well screened by mature planting and established shrubs. Opening directly onto the garden, it creates a wonderful space to enjoy all year around. The garden features a variety of attractive species including camellia, magnolia, skimmia, euonymus, pieris and box, creating year-round interest. Several mature apple and fruit trees add charm and character, while a generous lawned area to one side of the property emphasises the impressive width of the plot and offers potential for further landscaping or extension (subject to the necessary consents). A terrace patio provides an ideal space for outdoor dining and entertainment during the warmer months. Tucked discreetly within the garden is a large rhododendron, behind which sits a useful tool shed, along with a built-in wood store. A particularly attractive feature is the generous summer house, complete with large sliding doors, providing a peaceful retreat to enjoy all year round overlooking the garden. The breadth of the plot and existing footprint present significant potential for extending the property to either side, offering exciting possibilities for future development (subject to planning permission). LOCATION WYTHALL Weatheroak sits on the outskirts of Earlswood and Wythall, both highly sought-after semi-rural areas with an excellent balance of countryside living and city accessibility. Situated just south of Birmingham and close to Solihull, the area is ideally suited to families, professionals and commuters alike. The village benefits from excellent transport connections, with the nearby M42 motorway and A435 road providing straightforward access to Stratford-upon-Avon and the wider Midlands. Rail services from Wythall railway station and Whitlocks End railway station offer regular connections into central Birmingham, including Birmingham Moor Street railway station and Birmingham Snow Hill railway station, while Birmingham Airport is conveniently located within a short drive. Wythall itself offers a range of everyday amenities including local shops, cafés and services. Families are particularly well served by a selection of well-regarded primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area. Leisure opportunities are plentiful, with Wythall Park providing sports pitches, children’s play areas and community events, while the surrounding countryside offers excellent opportunities for walking and outdoor pursuits. Local attractions include several golf courses, sports clubs and the much-loved Wythall Transport Museum. SOLIHULL Historically part of Warwickshire, Solihull is one of the most prosperous towns in the English Midlands. In November 2013, the uSwitch Quality of Life Index named Solihull the “best place to live” in the United Kingdom. The motto of Solihull is Urbs in Rure (Town in Country). Solihull’s name is commonly thought to have derived from the position of its parish church, St Alphege, on a ‘soily’ hill. The church was built on a hill of stiff red marl, which turned to sticky mud in wet weather. Solihull probably came into being about a thousand years ago, as a clearing in the forest to which people would come to trade. The town is noted for its historic architecture, which includes surviving examples of timber framed Tudor style houses and shops. The historic Solihull School dates from 1560 (although not on its present site). The red sandstone parish church of St. Alphege dates from a similar period. Excellent communication links with the M42 (J4 and J5) which provides access to the M40 providing motorway access to London, the M6 and the North West and the M5 and the South West. Birmingham International Airport is a short drive away, as well as the hub of the Midlands rail network, the newly refurbished New Street. Solihull train station provides direct access to London Marylebone.
