results.summary: Looking for that home that still gives you space, even if you are a larger than average or multi-generational household, well then look no more. Situated on a modern residential estate with other like-minded families in the Rotton Park area of Birmingham, this 2.5 storey detached property is nestled on a popular estate, lying right on the Edgbaston & Smethwick border. It offers very generous room sizes because the accommodation is split over the three floors instead of the usual two. Built in approx 2007 as a part of the Butlers Wharf development, the property is surrounded by parks and small greens for those families with small children or pets. The popular Summerfield Park & Edgbaston Reservoir offer a place of tranquility, whilst the city lights and hustle and bustle of Birmingham City Centre are less than two miles away.. The property itself has been relatively well maintained so on the face of it, doesn't really appear to require any of the unexpected works you might think of, however as with any average family household, does require some light cosmetic redecoration. It does come with no upward chain and a house alarm. The double fronted symmetry to this building is one of the reasons why these house types sell very well, as they are considered to be very desirable. The Red brick built home comprises of an entrance hallway, guest wc, through lounge, through kitchen-diner, separate utility, first floor landing with storage cupboard, family bathroom, 4 x double bedrooms with the master bedroom having an ensuite, second floor landing with more storage, gas central heating, tarmac driveway for two vehicles, single brick built detached garage and both front and rear gardens. Local amenities include Edgbaston Community Sports Ground, the newly built Metropolitan Super Hospital, the many various fast food outlets, local shops and other small business stretched along Cape Hill are an example of the sense of community here with most of these businesses being those of local residents. A variety of bus routes and other forms of public transport link the area to the neighboring towns of Bearwood, Smethwick, Sandwell, Hockley, Soho, Edgbaston, Harborne & Oldbury. Being in such a densely populated area, naturally there are numerous schools to choose from, both Primary School & Secondary Schools to choose from, such as George Dixon Academy, Shireland Technology, Windsor Olympus & Barford Primary. Front of Property To the front of the property from the footpath is a slabbed pathway with Red feature brick pillars and Ironmongery marking the boundary to the plot. To one side of the front garden is a convex shaped lawned area with a variety of plant life, shrubs and bushes. Whilst on the other side there is a tarmac driveway leading up to the single garage located at the side of the house. It is via a side gate up the driveway that you can access the rear garden. Ground Floor Entrance Hall Composite front door leading into the accommodation with a tiled floor, radiator, alarm panel, doors to the lounge, kitchen and guest wc and C-shape staircase leading up the first floor. Lounge 17'01 x 9'01 Window to the front, TV point, Tel point, laminated flooring, radiator and patio doors leading into the rear garden and a door leading back into the entrance hallway. Guest WC Low level wc, ceramic pedestal wash hand basin with Chrome mixer taps over, radiator and extractor fan. Kitchen-Diner 17'05 x 9'09 Window to the front and rear, tiled flooring, wall mounted combi boiler, Matt black wall & base units with work surfaces over, integral electric oven and 4 burner gas hob and cooker hood over, stainless steel sink and drainer with mixer tap over and splash back tiling, radiator and doors leading into the entrance hallway and utility room. Utility Room 6'06 max 4'03 max Stainless steel sink and drainer with mixer taps over, tiled flooring, fitted cupboards with surfaces over, space and plumbing facilities for a washing machine and a PVC & glazed door leading out into the rear garden. First Floor First Floor Landing Window to the front, storage cupboard, doors leading into two bedroom and the family bathroom C-shaped staircase rising to the second floor landing and down to the ground floor. Master Bedroom 17'06 x 9'04 max Double aspect windows to the front and rear, radiator, TV & Tel point an doors leading into the ensuite and the first floor landing. Ensuite Shower Room 7'07 x 4'03 Obscure window to the rear, low level wc, ceramic pedestal wash hand basin with taps over, fitted shower cubicle with electric shower and being partly tiled throughout and an extractor fan. Bedroom 1 10'10 x 9'09 Double aspect windows to front and side, radiator and a door leading back out onto the first floor landing. Bedroom 2 14'10 into dorma x 10'00 Triple aspect with a dorma window to the front, skylight to the rear and window to the side, radiator, laminated flooring and a storage cupboard/. Bedroom 3 14'09 into dorma x 9'09 Triple aspect with a dorma window to the front, a window to the side and a a skylight to the rear, laminated flooring an a storage cupboard. Family Bathroom Obscure window to the front, low level wc, ceramic pedestal wash hand basin and mixer tap over, fitted panel bath with Chrome mixer shower over, radiator, tiled flooring, extractor fan and part tiling to splash prone areas. Second Floor Second Floor Landing Doors leading into both bedrooms and a storage cupboard. Rear Garden This property offers a very simple and basic approch to a rear garden with a slabbed patio area opening up to a large lawn and provides access to the garage and driveway via the side gate. There is a security light and a combination of paneled fencing a brick walls to mark the boundaries to the plot. There is also an outside water supply. Single Garage Brick built garage with a slate pitched roof. Access is gained from the front of the house via the up and over door on the driveway, or via the PVC and glazed composite door which is accessed from the rear garden. Internally, the home features an inviting hallway leading into a large, open-plan extended living and dining room, ideal for modern family living and entertaining. To the first floor, a spacious landing gives access to two generous double bedrooms and a modern family bathroom. Externally, the rear of the property offers a low-maintenance garden with direct access to the garage, providing both practicality and outdoor enjoyment. With no upward chain, this property presents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers or those seeking a comfortable and well-located home in a popular residential area. results.summary: A stylish and well presented second floor two bedroom apartment located in the vibrant and rapidly growing neighbourhood of Digbeth, just minutes from Birmingham city centre. This contemporary home offers bright living spaces, secure parking, and access to a communal roof terrace with panoramic views across the Birmingham skyline. This beautifully presented apartment offers modern city living in one of Birmingham's most exciting locations. The spacious open plan living area features patio style doors opening onto a Juliet balcony, allowing natural light to fill the space throughout the day. The kitchen has been updated with a newly fitted oven, hob and extractor hood, while the bathroom benefits from a new shower and modern taps. The property also features a modern boiler installed approximately two years ago, offering added efficiency and peace of mind. The apartment includes a spacious master bedroom and a well proportioned second double bedroom, making it ideal for professionals or couples seeking a comfortable and well maintained home in a highly sought after urban neighbourhood. This property is also suitable for buyers looking for an investment property for long term letting. Situated in Digbeth, the apartment is positioned within Birmingham’s creative and cultural quarter, an area known for its unique character, street art, music venues and independent businesses. Digbeth is one of the oldest parts of Birmingham, with settlements dating back to the 7th century, and has transformed from an industrial hub into a thriving centre for arts, technology and creative industries. The neighbourhood continues to attract significant regeneration and investment, with ongoing redevelopment and infrastructure projects enhancing long term value and helping to make Digbeth one of the most exciting places to live in Birmingham. Residents enjoy easy access to: • Independent restaurants, cafés and bars • Creative hubs such as the Custard Factory • Birmingham city centre and the Bullring shopping district • Major transport connections including Birmingham New Street Station, Moor Street and Digbeth Coach Station. The apartment also benefits from an allocated parking space within a secure on site car park, adding convenience and peace of mind in this central location. A standout feature of the building is the communal roof terrace, providing residents with an impressive outdoor space to relax or socialise while enjoying panoramic views across the Birmingham skyline. The development also benefits from a strong sense of community, supported by neighbourhood watch, litter picking and street watch initiatives that help keep the area safe and well maintained. results.summary: A detached house with excellent potential in a highly desirable location. Existing accommodation includes porch, reception hall, living room, dining kitchen, utility, four good bedrooms, house bathroom. Scope for extensions (subject to consents). Situation The property is situated in this highly regarded location within the Knightlow Park private development, on the doorstep of a children's play area and fitness trail. The property is also within area and fitness trail. The property is also within comfortable reach to the heart of Harborne Village which provides a wealth of highly regarded restaurants, bars and cafes. Key locations which are also within easy reach include Queen Elizabeth Medical Complex, Birmingham University and Birmingham City Centre all of which have local transport links readily accessible. The range of excellent leisure venues within the area including Birmingham Botanical Gardens, Edgbaston Priory Club and Edgbaston Cricket Ground. Description This four bedroomed family home offers approximately 1300sqft of internal accommodation additionally benefitting from off-street parking and a double garage, with scope for possible additional development subject to the relevant planning permissions. results.summary: HomeMove Estate Agents is pleased to offer this stunning two-bedroom townhouse located in the ever-popular Smethwick area of Birmingham. The accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, ground floor cloakroom, front kitchen, rear lounge/diner, two bedrooms, an ensuite to the master bedroom and a family bathroom. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the condition and accommodation on offer. On entering the property, the hallway gives immediate access to the left to a storage cupboard and further along a ground-floor cloakroom. To the right is the kitchen, which is fitted out with a range of wall and base units, including a built-in oven, hob with extractor over, as well as a fridge/freezer. There is yet further space and plumbing for other appliances to be connected. Further back into the property is the main living area, which is the full width of the property and has French doors out into the garden as well as stairs leading off to the first-floor landing. The first-floor accommodation benefits from having two double bedrooms, and the master bedroom has access to its own ensuite shower room. There is also a family bathroom comprising a panel bath, a wash hand basin and a low-level flush WC Outside, to the rear, there is a low-maintenance private garden offering a decked patio leading to a lawn area and with the benefit of a garden shed. results.summary: This striking three-bedroom duplex penthouse is set high above Birmingham in The Lancaster at Snow Hill Wharf, offering more than 1,600 square feet of beautifully designed living space. Arranged over the top two floors, it combines dramatic architecture, with vaulted ceilings reaching over five metres, and contemporary finishes throughout. Available either furnished or unfurnished, it provides a rare opportunity to enjoy both style and flexibility, with the added benefit of secure parking for three cars. External and Communal Areas The Lancaster forms part of the award-winning Snow Hill Wharf development, positioned along the Birmingham and Fazeley Canal. The setting is both vibrant and peaceful, with landscaped podium gardens for residents to enjoy, while the city unfolds just beyond. On-site facilities are first-class, including a 24-hour concierge, private gym and wellness suite, cinema room, business spaces and resident lounges, creating a lifestyle that feels both exclusive and convenient. Ground Floor (Lower Level) The lower floor is home to the three bedrooms, each designed with fitted storage and its own en-suite bathroom. The main bedroom has a sense of calm luxury, with extensive wardrobes and a bathroom that includes both a bathtub and a generous walk-in shower. The second bedroom is equally well appointed, with bespoke storage and a sleek shower room. The third bedroom, currently arranged as a nursery, benefits from dual-aspect windows, fitted wardrobes and its own private shower room. Practical touches, including additional storage and a separate cupboard housing the washer and dryer, are also found on this level. First Floor (Upper Level) The upper floor is an expansive, light-filled space where living, dining and kitchen areas flow together beneath soaring ceilings and full-height windows. The kitchen, with its stone worktops, integrated appliances and central island, is designed for both entertaining and everyday life. The adjoining living and dining spaces open up beautifully to the views beyond, creating an atmosphere that is both impressive and welcoming. A guest cloakroom is also located on this level. Parking Unusually for a city-centre home, the property includes secure underground parking for three vehicles, arranged as a single bay and a tandem space for two further cars. Location Snow Hill Wharf occupies a prime position in Birmingham's city core. Snow Hill and New Street stations are both within walking distance, Colmore Row and the business district are close by, and the city's finest restaurants, bars and retail destinations are all just moments away. The upcoming HS2 station at Curzon Street will only strengthen the excellent transport connections, while the waterside setting offers a rare sense of calm in the middle of the city. Tenure We have been advised that this property is leasehold, however, prospective buyers are advised to verify the position with their solicitor / legal representative. Length of lease - 244 years. Service Charge: £9,000 per annual Ground Rent: £765 per annual. Anti Money Laundering In accordance with the most recent Anti Money Laundering Legislation, buyers will be required to provide proof of identity and address to Rock Innovate Limited once an offer has been submitted and accepted (subject to contract) prior to Solicitors being instructed. results.summary: This beautifully presented, three-bedroom, end of terrace house is newly built; situated in Longbridge the property presents a generous lounge, a spacious fitted kitchen/diner, ground floor WC, utility cupboard, a contemporary bathroom, en-suite shower room and a double drive. Approaching the property, the double drive allows parking for multiple vehicles with a paved path giving access to the front door. Entering to the hall, there is plenty of space for removing outdoor footwear and jackets. The generous lounge hosts space for multiple suites and freestanding furniture with integral storage cupboards. The spacious fitted kitchen/diner is modern and hosts an integral fridge/freezer, electric oven, gas hob, dishwasher and sink with drain. The diner area offers space for a dining table and chairs with a utility cupboard presenting additional counterspace and space/plumbing for freestanding appliances. Additionally, there is side access to the garden through double French doors. The ground floor is completed by a WC. Ascending to the first-floor landing, Bedroom One presents a spacious double looking to the front aspect, hosting space for freestanding furniture, an integral wardrobe and access to an adjoining en-suite shower room which hosts a washbasin, WC and shower. Bedroom Two is also a large double looking to the front aspect, additionally hosting an integral wardrobe. Bedroom Three is the final double which looks to the side aspect and similarly hosts an integral wardrobe. The garden opens to a paved patio presenting space for freestanding furniture and external storage. This continues to a grass laid lawn allowing for outdoor activities. The garden is bordered by wooden panel fencing. This location is ideal for families, situated in close proximity to Longbridge Shopping Park providing ease of access to local amenities such as shops, supermarkets, restaurants and recreational grounds such as The Lickey Hills and Cofton Park, several primary and secondary schools, plus Longbridge train station and the A38. To the rear, the fitted kitchen provides good storage and worktop space, with room for everyday cooking and access out to the garden. Utility area and downstairs w/c. Upstairs, there are two well proportioned bedrooms, all finished in light, neutral colours. Although there is a family bathroom there is also an additional generous size bathroom which completes the first floor with a simple, modern finish. On the second floor you will find the third bedroom. Outside, the rear garden offers private outdoor space for relaxing or entertaining. There is also a summer house at the rear of the garden that could be used as an office/gym etc. Hurst Lane is well placed for local shops, parks, schools and transport links across Birmingham and towards the motorway network. results.summary: A superbly maintained four bedroom detached property situated in this highly desirable cul-de-sac location within Harborne. Boasting approximately 1300sqft of internal accommodation additionally benefitting from off-street parking and a double garage. Additionally the property has excellent scope for further extension and redevelopment subject to the relevant planning permissions. Being Sold with No Upward Chain. The property is set back away from the road with a driveway suitable for two cars that leads to the attached garage and property entrance. As you enter you are greeted by an entrance porch-way that leads into a welcoming hallway with cloakroom. There is a large lounge with triple aspect windows to the front and rear with sliding patio doors out to the rear garden. An equally spacious refitted kitchen-dining room provides ample space for dining room furniture with a modern breakfast kitchen which includes a breakfast bar area. The kitchen itself comprises wall and base level units with complimentary work surfaces, and tiled splash-back with ceramic sink and drainer. There is an integrated oven with electric hob and extractor fan and a free-standing dishwasher. The downstairs is completed with a utility/wet-room providing fridge-freezer, washing machine and tumble dryer with a fully-tiled walk-in shower cubicle. The upstairs accommodation includes four good sized double bedrooms which all include fitted wardrobes or storage and a partly tiled re-fitted family bathroom suite. A large garage complete with power and light completes the internal accommodation which also provides access through to the well-maintained and beautifully secluded wrap-around garden, stretching across the side and rear of property. The property is situated in this highly regarded location within the Knightlow Park private development, on the doorstep of a children's play area and fitness trail. The property is also within comfortable reach to the heart of Harborne Village which provides a wealth of highly regarded restaurants, bars and cafes. Key locations which are also within easy reach include Queen Elizabeth Medical Complex, Birmingham University and Birmingham City Centre all of which have local transport links readily accessible. The range of excellent leisure venues within the area including Birmingham Botanical Gardens, Edgbaston Priory Club and Edgbaston Cricket Ground. Estate agents operating in the UK are required to conduct Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks in compliance with the regulations set forth by HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) for all property transactions. It is mandatory for both buyers and sellers to successfully complete these checks before any property transaction can proceed. Our estate agency uses Coadjute’s Assured Compliance service to facilitate the AML checks. A fee will be charged for each individual AML check conducted. results.summary: VIEWINGS RECOMMENDED FOR THIS BEAUTIFULLY PRESENTED THREE BEDROOM SEMI DETACHED RESIDENCE. The accommodation comprises of Porch, Hallway, Two Reception Rooms, Kitchen, Utility, Ground Floor W.C, Three First Floor Bedrooms, Family Shower-Room, Garden, Garage and Off-Road Parking. Energy Performance Rating: TBC. Council Tax Band: D. LOCATION: Tenbury Road is situated off the Alcester Road South, Kings Heath a suburb of Birmingham, five miles South of the city centre. It is the next suburb South from Moseley on the A435. Kings Heath is a very popular area which grew around the High Street where there are many restaurants, cafes and shops plus an excellent bus service into and out of the city centre. The area is also best known for its wide range of outstanding primary and secondary schools and great transport links in and out of the city centre. Kings Heath has two delightful parks; Kings Heath Park features a Victorian-styled tea room and is well known for its unusual plants and trees and Highbury park which is located on the border of Moseley is also very popular with local residents. HOW TO GET THERE: Enter into Sat Nav: B14 6AH GENERAL ADVICE: Before travelling a distance to view any property, to get a feel for a locality, many think it’s worthwhile exploring the setting on Google Earth / Google Maps Street View SUMMARY: * This well-presented three-bedroom semi-detached property offers spacious and practical accommodation, ideal for families or first-time buyers. The home benefits from off-road parking and a private garage, providing convenient and secure parking. * Entrance is via a porch which leads into a generous sized reception hallway, creating a welcoming first impression. The hallway provides access to the main ground floor accommodation, the staircase rising to the first floor, and features an understairs storage cupboard along with space for coats and additional furnishings if desired. * The property benefits from two well-proportioned reception rooms, offering versatile living space. The front reception room features an attractive bay window which allows for plenty of natural light and provides a pleasant outlook to the front. The second reception room is positioned to the rear of the property and benefits from a door leading directly out to the garden, creating an ideal space for dining, entertaining, or relaxing while enjoying views of the outdoor area. * The kitchen is fitted with a range of base cupboards and wall-mounted units, providing ample storage and worktop space. It benefits from an integrated cooker with induction hob and extractor fan above. There is also space provided for a fridge freezer, making the kitchen both practical and functional for everyday use. * Accessed via the kitchen, the utility room provides a practical additional workspace with some base cupboards and a sink unit. The room offers space and plumbing for a washing machine and tumble dryer, making it ideal for laundry and additional storage. The utility area also benefits from a ground floor W.C. and a useful storage cupboard/pantry. Further features include internal access to the garage and a door leading out to the rear garden. * The first floor comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms, all offering generous accommodation. One of the bedrooms benefits from built-in storage, providing convenient wardrobe space, while the remaining bedrooms offer ample room for bedroom furnishings and can be easily adapted to suit a variety of needs such as guest accommodation, a child’s room, or a home office. * The property benefits from a generously sized shower room fitted with a W.C., freestanding wash hand basin, and a large shower cubicle. The room also includes a useful cupboard housing the boiler, providing discreet storage. Overall, the space is well-proportioned and offers a practical and comfortable facility for everyday use. * The property boasts a generously sized rear garden which extends a considerable distance, offering excellent outdoor space. Immediately to the rear of the property is a paved patio area, providing ample room for outdoor seating and currently housing a garden shed. Beyond the patio, the garden is mainly laid to lawn with a pathway leading through. To the left-hand side there is a greenhouse with bordering greenery, ideal for those with a passion for gardening. Continuing further along, the garden opens to an additional lawned area with stepping stones guiding you towards the rear. At the far end of the garden there is a further shed set within a section laid with a mixture of paved patio and decorative pebbled stones. The garden also benefits from a number of planters, making it a perfect space for keen gardeners to cultivate plants and flowers while still enjoying plenty of open lawn space. results.summary: ***Oakmans are Delighted to Offer this Beautifully Presented Four Bedroom Executive Home*** A thoughtfully designed four-bedroom detached modern home, offering spacious and versatile accommodation throughout. The property benefits from a large driveway and garage, providing ample off-road parking. Inside, the home has been modernised throughout and offers an excellent layout for modern family living, featuring a generous open-plan kitchen/diner with snug area, perfect for both entertaining and everyday life. The entrance hallway leads to a welcoming front reception room, with doors opening through to the impressive open-plan dining area and kitchen, complete with a large central island. A utility area and downstairs are convenient additions. From the dining space, you can access the fabulous conservatory, which features a charming log burner and enjoys lovely views over the garden. The well-planned rear garden provides a relaxing outdoor space and includes a summerhouse and garden shed, ideal for storage or hobbies. Upstairs, the generous master bedroom benefits from a private ensuite, while three further bedrooms offer excellent accommodation for family members, guests, or flexible home working space. The property is conveniently located close to local amenities, schools, and transport links, making it an ideal home for families. Perfect for multi-generational living or those requiring convenient ground floor accommodation. The property is approached via a driveway providing off-road parking. Inside, the hallway leads to a generously sized lounge/diner, which opens through sliding doors into the garden room. The garden room features an external door to the tiered rear garden and a connecting door to an inner hallway, giving access to the shower room and kitchen. The hallway also provides direct access to the ground floor bedroom. Upstairs, the first-floor landing offers access to the master bedroom and two further double bedrooms. A large family bathroom completes the accommodation. Externally, the property benefits from a tiered rear garden with decking and lawn, fully enclosed by fencing, providing a private and secure outdoor space. The property is situated in Fairway, Northfield, a well-established residential area in the south of Birmingham. Northfield offers a range of local amenities including shops, supermarkets, schools, healthcare facilities, and leisure services. The area benefits from good transport links, with nearby bus routes and Northfield Train Station providing convenient access to Birmingham City Centre and surrounding areas. The property is also within easy reach of the A38 and M5 motorway network, making it ideal for commuters. results.summary: A two bedroom, two bathroom apartment situated in the popular Maxim 28 development benefiting from allocated secure parking, no onward chain and being situated in Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter. The development is accessed via pedestrian and vehicle security doors and gates, opening into the courtyard area. The building has a further security door opening got a communal hallway with access to the third floor via the communal lift or stair well. The apartment opens into a initial entrance hall giving access to the accommodation. There is an open plan kitchen, lounge/diner with the Kitching having a range of matching floor and wall mounted units, electric oven, hob and extractor and space for appliances. The master bedroom has an en-suite shower and there is a second double bedroom. The family bathroom has a panelled bath with shower over, wash hand basin and low level w/c built into a vanity storage unit. The apartment benefits from having parking in the secure garage below the development and is being offered with no onward chain. results.summary: Oakmans Estate Agents are delighted to present this well-presented two-bedroom first-floor apartment, offered to the market with no onward chain, making it an excellent opportunity for both first-time buyers and investors. The apartment is located within the highly sought-after The Oakes development, a modern residential scheme known for strong demand and excellent rental appeal. The property benefits from an allocated parking space and generous storage throughout. Internally, the accommodation comprises two well-proportioned double bedrooms, a modern family bathroom, and a bright open-plan kitchen and living area. The kitchen is well appointed and includes integrated appliances, such as a built-in washing machine and dishwasher, providing a sleek and functional living space. The property is leasehold and has been well maintained, offering a straightforward and low-maintenance purchase. The Oakes is superbly positioned for access to the University of Birmingham and the Queen Elizabeth Hospital Birmingham, both of which are within close proximity and help drive consistent rental demand. A range of local amenities including supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and everyday shops are also nearby. Transport links are excellent, with nearby train stations and regular bus routes providing easy access into Birmingham city centre and surrounding areas. This property represents a fantastic opportunity to purchase a modern apartment in a prime location, ideal for first-time buyers or those seeking a high-yield investment.
